description: This file defines the LabelService class, a core service component in a Java-based email application. It handles CRUD operations for labels, manages email-label associations, and provides methods for listing labels and emails filtered by labels, encapsulating business logic related to label management.

classes.name: LabelService
classes.description: A Spring service component managing labels and email-label relationships in an email suite.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of labels owned by a specific user.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new label for the owner, returns an Optional LabelDto.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing label if owned by the user, with optional name and color modifications.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a label and its associated email assignments for the owner.

methods.name: assignLabels
methods.description: Assigns a list of labels to an email, avoiding duplicate assignments.

methods.name: unassignLabels
methods.description: Removes specified labels from an email, if assigned.

methods.name: listEmailsByLabel
methods.description: Lists emails associated with a specific label, with pagination, maintaining order.
